prompts.rat: Use case: stylized-concept. Production pixel-art game sprite, one original animal design only. A finished low resolution sprite enlarged with perfectly sharp nearest-neighbor square pixels, clean broad clusters, maximum 12 colors, coherent silhouette, no speckled texture. Shallow isometric 3/4 view for a gritty underground cyberpunk server room, slightly looking down. Restrained dark blue-teal shadows and warm amber edge illumination. Actual transparent background, no checkerboard, no ground, no shadow, no text, no frame, no environment. Subject centered with generous empty padding, all extremities visible. No blur or soft antialiasing. This will be drawn only around 25 pixels wide in a game so favor clarity over fine details. A scruffy small grey-brown rat facing right, long thin curved pink-brown tail extending left, rounded ears, pointed nose, four tiny paws below a low arched back. A tiny copper wire collar, one muted amber eye, natural animal anatomy. Neutral standing pose, relaxed but curious, roughly 32x16 source-pixel design. Not a mouse, not bipedal, no costume.
